Definition: the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot
BiblicalUsage: The thumb is the word for the thumb of the hand and the great toe of the foot, always used of both together. In Exodus 29:20 the blood is put on the thumb of Aaron's right hand and the great toe of his right foot, and in Leviticus 8:23 Moses does the same at the consecration. In Judges 1:6 Adoni-bezek's thumbs and great toes are cut off, and in Judges 1:7 he says seventy kings gathered their meat under his table with their thumbs cut off.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the thumb and the toe in the consecration are the point: the priest's hands and feet both belong to God, from the tip of the ear to the great toe.
